value_conventions.stat: A talent stat. Any talent declaring it, alongside a nearby_spawn_radius, strengthens mobs spawning near its owner.
value_conventions.attribute: The attribute that stat moves on the spawned mob.
value_conventions.operation: addition, multiply_base, or multiply_total. multiply_base makes several talents add up; multiply_total makes them compound.
value_conventions.enabled: false switches the row off without deleting it.
